What happens when a whole site is down
GSLB → S1 gateway; Sentinels #2 + #3 promote S1 Redis;
S1 coordinator signs with nodes 1 + 2; chain: 4 of 6 validators = quorum
no user impact: Center signs with nodes 0 + 2;
chain 4 of 6 · DR capacity lost until S1 returns
no user impact: Center signs with nodes 0 + 1;
by design: signing stops (1 of 3 shares) and chain halts
(2 of 6 < quorum). No single site can sign or produce blocks alone.
